description: The chart represents the distribution of task types, showing two categories. The chart is divided into two slices, with "Article generation" being the larger slice, colored red, and making up approximately 83.2% of the chart, while the smaller slice, colored yellow, is labeled "generation" and accounts for around 16.8%. The chart includes percentage labels next to each slice, and the labels are also placed inside and outside the chart. The slices are not visually emphasized or exploded, and there is no legend present. The chart is presented in a donut chart format, with the title "Task Type" displayed in the center.
